# AI Music Video Guide

> Independent guides, honest tool comparisons, and free tools for making AI music videos.
> We help musicians and creators turn songs into full, lip-synced, beat-cut music videos with AI,
> and choose the right AI video tool. Reader-supported via affiliate links (disclosed).
